budget.on_conflict: present measured cost and ask user; never silently reduce coverage

required_evidence.capabilities: native only; project-added controllers must not count as native ability
required_evidence.architecture: source-grounded backbone for each method; pipeline means motor/dynamics controller, execution and state-feedback loop, NOT training-data processing
required_evidence.causality: paired native pretrained component and feedback-path interventions; estimate effects in the fixed pretrained system, not superiority of retrained architectures
required_evidence.training_policy: Retraining is not required and missing training data must not block pretrained inference
required_evidence.E: 1007 kinematic metrics plus RULA/REBA with complete inputs and explicit load assumptions
required_evidence.scope: human motion only, no humanoid robots
required_evidence.report_floor: 1007 content and interaction coverage; retain individual cases, comparable motion visuals, failures and metric explanations

engineering_requirements: One declarative method registry and experiment plan; do not hardcode a five-method CLI beside standalone workers
Separate native method, representation adapter, experiment intervention, executor and metric evaluator
Persist exact intervention, training/data/checkpoint identities and causal estimand
Budget uses a shared wall-clock deadline and per-device allocation, not summed GPU-hours as elapsed time
Declare unsupported native interfaces with source evidence; never substitute a project-added capability
Resume only when protocol, inputs, code and checkpoint identities match
Resource pilots support measurement; do not demand fabricated static bounds or bypass safety checks
